movieData.movieComments: Youtube has a lot of these DVD rom coms on their movie section and most of them aren't great. Paul Rudd is in this and I feel like they just had him show up and told him to improv everything. It's otherwise a forgettable movie.

I'm not sure this should be nominated for a best picture oscar. The movie kind of drags on in places and while the entire movie is based on a some weird biological psuedo science it forgets how basic physics works which kind of ruined my suspenion of disbelief. The monster can move a ship without falling through ice, a tnt explosion doesnt blast the monsters limbs off even though there just humans limbs, Victor sets fire to a stone castle, etc. The actor who played the monster Jacob Elordi did great though.
